[[File:Oathplate chest detail.png|150px|left]]
The '''oathplate chest''' is part of the [[oathplate armour]] set, requiring 78 [[Defence]] to wear. The chest is the only piece of body slot item to have a positive [[slash bonus]], excluding the [[Vesta's chainbody]] which is only usable in [[Bounty Hunter]]. As a [[Zamorak]]ian-aligned item, oathplate armour will give [[God Wars Dungeon#God equipment|Zamorakian protection]] within the [[God Wars Dungeon]].

The chest can be obtained directly as a drop from [[Yama]] or more rarely from [[forgotten lockbox]]es, which are also dropped by Yama. Alternatively, it can be created via [[Smithing]] by combining 2,520 [[crushed infernal shale]] with 450 [[oathplate shards]] to make 9 [[infernal plate]]s, then using them to smith one piece of oathplate armour.

Oathplate chests can be broken down at the [[Ancient Forge]] inside the [[Ancient Prison]] in the [[God Wars Dungeon]] for 50 oathplate shards, resulting in a profit of {{NoCoins|{{GEP|Oathplate shards|50}} - {{GEP|Oathplate chest}}}}.
